title: Claude Usage fork (PR #15): group duplicate logins and follow the account Claude Code is using
body:
## Decision

hv, 2026-11-03: one PR, #15, retitled and rewritten to carry the whole multi-account story. dc builds it after ISSUE:0003.

hv, 2026-11-04: closed as overtaken. Upstream merged PR #15 as it stood (`ecaf573`, `29a4db2`) on 2026-11-03 at 17:03Z and released it as v1.16, so it can no longer carry the rest. The duplicate this issue was for goes with ISSUE:0003's step 4: once the main config's own login is retired, the app's Keychain discovery finds the five profile logins alone. Not built: grouping by account (`4b116b9`), following `ccusage use`, naming the item from `CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR`, and `-a` on reads. A new PR can take them up if they are wanted.

## Context (2026-11-03)

- hv's fork of Claude Usage is at `~/Devel/forks/claudecodeusage` (remote `matthewsinclair/claudecodeusage`; upstream `richhickson/claudecodeusage`).
- Upstream PR #15, "Filter MCP-only credentials and use an account dropdown", comes from `fix/account-picker`. It is open and mergeable, with no reviews and no checks reported. It is two commits on upstream v1.15: a dropdown in place of tabs, MCP-only stores hidden, and a menu-bar colour that follows the selected account.
- Branch `fix/account-identity-preview` (`4b116b9`, not in the PR) groups duplicate logins by account and organisation UUID from `/api/oauth/profile`, preferring a working login and then the selected one, with six tests.
- The Claude Usage running on rhadamanth is hv's local Debug build of PR #15's head, `29a4db2`, from `build/local-test-selected-colour/` (ad hoc signed, built 2026-10-28 14:57, running since 2026-11-02 21:43). Its code, in `ClaudeUsage.debug.dylib`, has PR #15's dropdown and MCP filtering but not the grouping branch, which is why engineering.01 shows twice. `/Applications/ClaudeUsage.app` is upstream v1.15, signed by Rich's Developer ID, and is not running.
- Upstream's multi-profile support is Rich's own implementation, `d2fde5e` (v1.15, 2026-10-27, segmented tabs), written for issue #2 (nikspyratos) on top of hv's merged PR #14. PR #15 builds on it and is unmerged.
- The fork only reads. It discovers items with `security dump-keychain` (attributes only) and reads tokens with `security find-generic-password -s <service> -w`. It never refreshes or writes a credential. Keep it that way: Claude Code and ccusage own renewal (ISSUE:0002), and a third writer would bring back rotation races and partition-list changes.
- It resolves the config from `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` (the environment, else `launchctl getenv`, which is `/Users/matts/.config/claude` here) and computes the preferred item name once, at launch. It does not know `CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR`.

## Changes, in line with ISSUE:0002 and ISSUE:0003

1. Fold in `4b116b9`: one dropdown entry per account and organisation.
2. Follow the account Claude Code is using. At each refresh, read `oauthAccount.accountUuid` and `organizationUuid` from `.claude.json` in the config the app already resolves, and select the entry with that identity. In ccusage's shared mode `ccusage use` writes exactly that record, so the menu bar follows `ccusage use` with no ccusage-specific code. A manual pick holds until Claude Code's account changes.
3. Name the preferred item as Claude Code does, evaluated at each refresh rather than once at launch: `CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR` (the environment, else launchd; NFC-normalised; an empty value means no suffix) takes precedence over `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`.
4. Read with `-a <user>` as well as `-s <service>`, as Claude Code does, so an item another tool created under the same service name is never read.
5. Stay read-only, and say so in README and in the PR.

## The PR

Build on `fix/account-picker`, so PR #15 carries the whole multi-account story, and retitle it and rewrite its body to match. The push and the PR edit happen only with hv's OK at that moment, because they publish to an upstream repository.

## Acceptance

- `swift test` passes, including the six identity tests and new ones for following `oauthAccount` (match, no match, no record, and a manual pick held until the account changes), for the preferred item name (`CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR` set, empty and unset; NFC), and for `-a` in the read arguments.
- `xcodebuild` builds the app, and CI on the PR is green.
- A local build run on rhadamanth, as hv runs PR #15's today, raises no Keychain prompt, follows `ccusage use`, and lists five accounts once ISSUE:0003's rollout retires `ca646b28`.
